lines.text: [excited] What if you could just... type your battery? And see it in 3D?
Type something like: forty-eight volt e-bike, twenty amp-hours.
Or a runtime. Twenty-four volt robot, six hours at fifteen amps.
The Studio shows the voltage, capacity, energy, and the approximate size.
Happy with it? Send it over. Our engineers check the BMS, current and enclosure.
[excited] So what would YOU type first? Tell us in the comments!
